areas.name: Nong Pla Lai reservoir
areas.source: Reservoir named in Eastern Water (EASTW) pipeline network coverage (Bangkok Post, 2015: Nong Pla Lai, Dok Krai, Khlong Yai, Prasae). Outline from OpenStreetMap way 27940575 (อ่างเก็บน้ำหนองปลาไหล), box = outline bounding box plus 0.007 degrees.
areas.notes: Water extent proxy. Reservoirs are state owned; EASTW draws and sells from the connected system, so this is a partial, indirect proxy.

areas.name: KTIS Takhli cane catchment
areas.source: Head office and factory at 1/1 Moo 14, Nong Pho Sub-District, Taklee District, Nakhon Sawan (KTIS Annual Report 2020; SEC Thailand company profile market.sec.or.th KTIS). Centre is the OpenStreetMap position of Nong Pho / Takhli built-up area, accurate to a few km only.
areas.notes: Cane catchment proxy, radius is an assumption. Mixed land cover: cane, rice, other crops, towns.

areas.name: KSL Nam Phong cane catchment
areas.source: Branch I factory at 43 Moo 10, Namphong-Kranuan Road, Nam Phong, Khon Kaen 40140, max 40,000 t cane/day (KSL 56-1 One Report 2022, p.11 and note 1). Centre is the OpenStreetMap position of Nam Phong town, accurate to a few km only.
areas.notes: Cane catchment proxy, radius is an assumption. Mixed land cover.

areas.name: KSL Wang Saphung cane catchment
areas.source: Branch II factory at 255 Moo 4, Nong Ya Plong Sub-district, Wangsaphung District, Loei 42130, max 36,000 t cane/day (KSL 56-1 One Report 2022, p.11 and note 1). Centre is the OpenStreetMap hamlet Ban Nong Ya Plong, accurate to a few km only.
areas.notes: Cane catchment proxy, radius is an assumption. Hilly terrain, mixed land cover.

areas.name: Rocket Lab LC-1, Mahia
areas.source: Launch Complex 1, southern Mahia Peninsula, New Zealand. Point 39.26085 S, 177.86586 E from Wikipedia and the Space Devs database; box is 3 km square around it.
areas.notes: Launch pad and apron surface change; a small site, so few pixels at 10 m.

areas.name: Rocket Lab Wallops LC-2 and LC-3
areas.source: Rocket Lab pads LC-2 (Electron) and LC-3 (Neutron), Wallops Island, Virginia. Point from Wikipedia-derived pad tables (about 37.833 N, 75.488 W); sources differ by a few hundred metres; box is 3 km square.
areas.notes: Construction and surface change at the Neutron complex, opened August 2025.

areas.name: Highview Power Carrington
areas.source: Trafford Low Carbon Energy Park beside the former Carrington Power Station, Greater Manchester (point 53.4358 N, 2.4109 W from Wikipedia for the power station; the plant site is adjacent); box is 2.4 km square.
areas.notes: Construction progress of the liquid air storage plant, started 2025.
